title: Classical Limits of Spectral Filtering in Quantum Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.14169v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spectral filtering has been proposed as a route to regularization in quantum generative models: the quantum Fourier transform exposes the amplitude spectrum of a quantum circuit Born machine, and a diagonal filter suppresses the high frequencies associated with finite-sample noise, an operation whose classical counterpart seemingly requires manipulating an exponentially long amplitude vector. We examine whether this coherent operation produces anything that classical post-processing of samples from the unfiltered model cannot match. Measuring the filter against convolution with a symmetric probability kernel at matched sampling cost, which accounts for the post-selection overhead of attenuation, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for the gap between the two to vanish. translated_title: 量子生成模型中谱过滤的经典极限
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14169v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：谱过滤已被提出作为量子生成模型正则化的一种途径：量子傅里叶变换暴露了量子电路玻恩机的幅度谱，而对角滤波器抑制了与有限样本噪声相关的高频成分，这一操作的经典对应物似乎需要操作指数长的幅度向量。我们研究了这种相干操作是否产生了未经滤波模型样本的经典后处理无法匹敌的结果。在匹配采样成本下，将滤波器与对称概率核卷积进行比较，这考虑了衰减的后选择开销，我们推导了两者差距消失的充分必要条件。幅度（衰减）滤波器遵循二分法：在固定的可负担阈值下，滤波输出要么是一个具有高效表示的常数大小傅里叶对象，要么是...
tldr: 本文证明了量子生成模型中谱过滤的经典极限，指出其效果在匹配采样成本下可由经典后处理等效实现，并给出了差距消失的充要条件。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the classical limits of spectral filtering in quantum generative models, showing that its effect can be matched by classical post-processing at equal sampling cost, with necessary and sufficient conditions for the gap to vanish.
